scope: Scarlet Invocation reward set (docs/encounters/crimson-foundry/REWARDS.md): the Scarlet Score Reliquary Victory drop and opening show, Sable Scythe, Canticle Organ, Scarlet Baton, Ember Censer and Bloodink Quill, and the Scarlet Covenant re-crafted from the five weapons (1500 damage, mana 10, 緋の契約, stops while its owner is dead or Down). Owner-client weapons with native projectile replication; reward ink through new ScarletInk.fx path passes and one shared renderer drawn beneath every Raid's forecasts. No packet, protocol, persistence or Raid behaviour change

owner_direction: 2026-10-02: a reward set built like Waltz of the Ebon Manor's (box, one weapon per class, companion from all five). Owner defaults for the open decisions: the reliquary is a shared world item, one per frozen member at the field's ground centre; quill ink stays where it was written; the Covenant stops while its owner is dead or Down; keep the spec's damage and mana numbers. Art from Codex was played as vanilla placeholders until delivered; on 2026-10-03 its recommended candidates were exported (selections in REWARDS.md#art-and-audio)
review_fixes: Staff Reap's lock lives on the player (released until the follow-through ends), so an item swap no longer cuts a release short
the Covenant recipe is not decraftable, so Shimmer cannot turn an old Grimoire-recipe Covenant into the five weapons
every staff engraving after the first republishes from the carrier's own AI (netUpdate was cleared before it), so peers see the whole staff
root ledgers have a bit for each of the 200 NPC slots (the old 64-root cap failed open)
the dormant build's lip lies inside the dried scar at ResiduePass's fade-0.6 strength instead of two hairlines outside it
reward ink is drawn first by every Raid's forecast drawer (Azure, Scarlet, Ebon, Doll, Ghost Samurai) through Client/Graphics/FriendlyWorldInk, independent of ModSystem order
live reward ink closes over its last 6 ticks into the scar it dries into (style.w), with no burning cap behind a moving tail and no doubled cap or lip ring at the joint
Reduced Effects halves particles once, where they are spawned
the opened reliquary stays where it opened, so the glow, its light, droplets, staff and burn share one place
censer and quill bodies restart the projectile batch only for a sampler it lacks; additive accents are alpha-0 colours in the AlphaBlend batch
the sprite table records icon texel scale (item and buff icons exported at 2 texels per logical pixel)
tests derive the Covenant's 16-20x and the Ebon comparison from their rules, check the nominal table, the one reward pool, exact localization keys and the Raid shader prefix hash
docs: CHANGELOG, BatonSwing state row, stale constants and comments, unverified assumptions
